neighbours.label: the subject naming the left-unchanged side of a contrast (the control group, the rest, the other ones), after another part was treated or changed, read before its predicate
neighbours.short: the untouched side of a contrast
neighbours.notes: Probes (52 sentences, both poles): peaks on the remainder/control subject noun before its verb: 'the control mice' 0.28, 'the rest of the house' 0.28, 'all the other layers' 0.26, 'the control samples' 0.31; treated or sequential versions ('the treated mice', 'and then the rest of the house') stay under 0.01. Persistence modals also fire ('an object in motion will keep moving' 0.51, 'secrets will probably never' 0.37) but less reliably ('Despite the protests, the policy will' 0.02), so they are left out of this label. The - pole looks like the other side: it fires on 'will' after a change event ('Once the law is repealed, the old rules will' 0.13, 'As soon as someone fixes the roof, the attic will' 0.17); not tested here.
fire: We fertilized half of the tomato plants, while the control plants got only plain water.
The surgeon replaced the damaged valve, but the rest of the heart looked perfectly healthy.
Volunteers in the first arm took the supplement, and the control group took a sugar pill.
We rewired the upstairs bedrooms last spring, but the rest of the building still has its original wiring.
Two of the folders were encrypted in the attack; all the other folders were untouched.
Only the front tires got swapped at the garage, and the rear ones were left as they were.
The museum sent three paintings away for cleaning, but the rest of the collection stayed on display.
Some pupils were given extra tutoring, while the control pupils followed the usual timetable.
quiet: We fertilized half of the tomato plants, and within a month the fertilized plants grew twice as tall.
The surgeon replaced the damaged valve, and the new valve started working right away.
Volunteers in the first arm took the supplement, and their blood pressure dropped within weeks.
Last spring an electrician rewired the upstairs bedrooms and finished the whole job in two days.
Two of the folders were encrypted in the attack, and the hackers demanded a ransom to unlock them.
Only the front tires got swapped at the garage, and the mechanic charged us for the new rubber.
Three paintings were sent away for cleaning, and the curators wrapped each one in soft cloth.
Some pupils were given extra tutoring, and the tutored pupils raised their grades by spring.
